after: Current local build sealed and installed; then verify actual idle terminal and assign
contract: Use the existing root authority via injected explicit registered-root provider; no arbitrary absolute path input or job/monitor grant substituted for browse permission
Metadata only, original Markdown authoritative; no note bytes, frontmatter edits or shadow writable vault
Opaque principal/root-identity/cursor-bound bounded scans; reauthorize across awaits and page continuations; expire sessions and expose partial/unavailable/denied
Relative path IDs stable by root+normalized relative path; filenames and paths only returned to explicitly authorized root callers
Canonical realpath plus directory device/inode checked; symlinks/mount escapes denied; bounded frontier, entries, bytes, elapsed work and cancellation
No second writable task/job database; project/job/attempt/artifact references do not confer filesystem authority
Backup coverage explicitly unverified; content digest unknown until bounded hashing separately authorized; no reclaimable or archive-ready inference

Tests use temporary fixture roots only, preserve all source bytes and Git state; include revocation, root replacement, symlink/FIFO races, cursor replay, deep/wide bounds, duplicate basenames and non-ASCII names
No uploads, deletes, hydration, eviction, network/provider requests, production root registration, deployments or Git mutations
Freeze exact source and test receipts, send questions to ROOT, reviewer BUILD2 after actual idle/source lock transfer
root_integration: Later ROOT wires existing Settings/Knowledge and runtime IPC/RPC; no parallel user-facing catalog application

native_incarnation_extension.contract: Exact provider/scope/token captured and checked on same no-follow FD; preserve original bytes and unrelated edits.
